newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen unchanged in becalmed market.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen unchanged in becalmed market.

text.p: Danish share prices opened unchanged on Thursday and dealers expected levels to hold or possible modest rises only in a becalmed summer market treading water ahead of August's interim corporate result season.
"We could see a few KFX orders this morning, but basically the market is going to be moribund now until we start getting the first-half 1997 corporate results next month," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index was unchanged at 188.80 at 0710 GMT, having closed 0.34 point higher on Wednesday.
